subject: Mutual action preflight: capacity & lead times — MAP for Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Kat Greene <k.greene@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action preflight: capacity & lead times — MAP for Dedicated/Private

Kat — following our call this morning, attaching a short preflight so we can lock the MAP items related to capacity reservation and close timeline. High level asks: 

- Confirm target production start date (you mentioned early Q4).
- Procurement / PO cadence and expected sign date from your side.
- Desired GPU pool sizing (p95 tokens/day) and acceptable latency SLOs.
- Whether this will be Dedicated (Redwood-managed GPU pool) or Private (VPC/on-prem) for the initial rollout.

Our constraints to call out up front: Dedicated lead time for H100 tranches is ~8–12 weeks from commitment (depends on region); Private on-prem/VPC installs add an installation window of ~4–6 weeks plus customer infra validation. For MAP planning we usually include a 2-week staging acceptance window and a 3-week buffer for any rework discovered during eval.

I've attached a short MAP preflight template with fields filled from today's notes — please complete the procurement calendar block and return by EOD Thursday so we can align the GPU tranche options.

Attachments: MAP-preflight-template.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the succinct breakdown. Quick answers and a couple clarifications: 

- Target production start: October 10, 2027 (we need go-live before our Q4 payer integration).
- Procurement timeline: internal approvals finish by 6/14, PO ready by 6/21; procurement calendar attached.
- Preferred deployment: start on Dedicated to reduce ops burden; consider Private for regulated subsets in phase 2.
- GPU sizing: initial estimate 600 p95 tokens/day for pilot, scale to 2.4k for full launch. Can you provide SLO tradeoffs if we opt for aggressive quantization vs more hardware?

I attached our procurement calendar (internal). We also need SOC2 evidence and a short statement about data residency for the Dedicated pool in us-west.

Attachment: helix_procurement_calendar.pdf (pdf)

Date: 2027-05-22T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: GPU sizing scenarios and lead-time options for Helix MAP

(Internal note) Naomi / Marissa — synth of sizing options based on Kat's numbers and our latency/cost tradeoffs. Sharing CSV with scenario rows. Key points: 

- Scenario A (Conservative): 4x A100 instances (quantized FP8), holds up to ~800 p95 tokens/day with 95th latency ~120ms; lead time for dedicated capacity tranche: 6–8 weeks.
- Scenario B (Balanced): 8x H100-packed nodes (mixed quant), scales to ~2.5k p95 tokens/day with 95th latency ~95ms; lead time: 8–12 weeks — recommended if Helix wants <100ms SLO.
- Scenario C (Private-ready): On-prem package + H100; installation window 4–6 weeks (post infra readiness), plus customer-run acceptance of 1–2 weeks.

Notes: We should propose a staggered tranche approach in the MAP: commit to Scenario B baseline, with an option to add a third tranche (for Private subset) at signature. That lets procurement move faster and leaves a clear acceptance window.

Attachments: gpu-sizing-scenarios.csv (csv)

Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-23T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan (draft) + tranche recommendation for Helix — please review

Hi Kat — based on your procurement dates and Ben's sizing options I put together a draft MAP and recommended tranche approach: 

Summary of proposed MAP milestones (high level):
- 2027-06-21: PO signed (Helix)
- 2027-06-28: Redwood reserves initial Dedicated tranche (Scenario B baseline)
- 2027-07-20: Initial staging cluster provisioned (us-west), onboarding eval window opens
- 2027-08-03: Staging acceptance complete (2-week buffer for regressions)
- 2027-09-08: Second tranche optional add (scale to full launch)
- 2027-10-10: Production go-live (Helix target)

Acceptance criteria for staging: throughput within 10% of baseline, <120ms 95th p95 for prioritized routes, and no data persistence in shared caches outside the VPC for Private subset. If acceptance fails, MAP includes a 3-week remediation plan and automatic fallback to reduced throughput mode.

We recommend signing for the Dedicated baseline (Scenario B) to meet the <100ms SLO and then adding a Private tranche for regulated workloads once procurement confirms network readiness. I've attached the MAP draft for review — please comment inline or provide timing updates. I also included a DocuSign link for a two-step signature: (1) baseline Dedicated tranche, (2) optional Private tranche addendum.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.docx (docx)
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/HLX-2027-0123, https://www.docusign.com/sign/HLX-MAP-2027

Thanks — if procurement stays on the calendar you shared we can meet all timeline checkpoints.

- Naomi

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan (draft) + tranche recommendation for Helix — please review

Thanks Naomi — this is very clear and actionable. Two small asks before we sign: 

1) Can we expand the staging acceptance window by one extra week (so 3 weeks total) for our security scans? That would push the staging completion to 2027-08-10 and still keep the Oct 10 go-live if we enable the small buffer in September.
2) For the Dedicated tranche, we require a short statement confirming that data processed during staging will not be retained beyond 48 hours in any shared cache — can you add that clause to the MAP?

If you can update and reissue the DocuSign by EOD Monday, procurement will be ready to route the PO on 6/14.

Best,
Kat
